(A) APDs received counts APDs received by the BLM and the APD Fee has been paid during the reporting period.

(B) APDs Pending includes cumulative APDs received without a final disposition. This includes the steps in the
process where the BLM is determining completeness of the application, or the Operator is addressing deficiencies such
as, Wildlife or Cultural Clearances, or the application is impacted by ongoing leasing litigation, and APDs awaiting
final decision.

(C) APDs Processed include APDs that are approved (column D), denied, returned, withdrawn, or cancelled.

(*) AAPDs are APDs that have been approved and are available to drill. These AAPDs are either in their original two-
year term or have been granted an extension beyond the first two years, but not to exceed a total of four years. This
AAPD number is accurate on the date that the report is generated, which is distinct from the data on APD status for the
month. Once an APD is drilled, expired, or withdrawn, it is removed from the Approved and Available (AAPDs)
numbers.
(**) Fiscal Year Totals Cover 10/01/2023 to 08/31/2024
Individual State Office data includes APD activity for both Federal and Tribal lands

Data current as of 10/24/2024
The data in this report is accurate as of the date it is pulled from the Automated Fluid Minerals Support System
(AFMSS). Changes to previously reported numbers that are then shown in later reports may result from ongoing data
quality control reviews. APD Processing takes several months from start to finish. This monthly report is a snapshot
during the process, so corrections may occur until the entire process for each APD is completed.

(*) AAPDs are APDs that have been approved and are available to drill. These AAPDs are either in their original two-
year term or have been granted an extension beyond the first two years, but not to exceed a total of four years. This
AAPD number is accurate on the date that the report is generated, which is distinct from the data on APD status for the

numbers.
